'''Intus Occident Stabling Sidings''' is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for . It is located between Woyi Gap Station and Intus Occident Gateway. This Stabling Siding is designed to support Katadelphia Depot and Spade Valley Stabling Sidings, as well as support train flow needed for the Western Extension of . This Stabling Siding is estimated to have a capacity of up to ten 9-carriage trains.

Description

Sidings

The two sides have five sidings each, which can store ten trains.

Connecting Tracks

The two ends of the stabling sidings connect to , with access to Woyi Gap Station to the west and Intus Occident Gateway to the east.

Other Facts

Besides of increasing the capacity for , this Stabling Siding is also constructed with enhancing dispatch frequencies in mind. This Stabling Siding is located under a mountain, and is hence underground. The trains parked in this Stabling Siding are also managed by Katadelphia Depot.

At the time of its closure, had a total of 3 stations, and only ran between and , but it had a planned service length of 37.5 km.

Line Characteristics and Fun Facts

Main Line (Islands Line)

  • This line is the longest District Railway line in Terracept Division, and also has the most stations.
  • While this line mainly runs in the south-north orientation, after passing through Terracept Terminal, it also detoured to southeast Terracept Continent before returning to the southwest at Tremend Sea.
  • While this line only had two termini, a spur line featuring three stations between and was featured. This layout alludes to Northern Line of the London Underground, and this line is the only line before of Los Sengas Division to feature such a layout.
  • According to the line system map at Terracept Terminal, this line had plans to extend three more stations from station, but it never came to fruition due to the closure of Terracept Division.

Express Line (Islands Express)

  • When Express Lines are also considered, this line is the last line to be established in the Terracept Division.
  • According to the Project Nazca Wiki, the express service had plans to extend to , but it never came to fruition due to the closure of Terracept Division.

Overall

  • This line is the only line in Nazca Railway history to feature both a spur line and an express service.
